facts.statement: The weekly community event focused on the Trading Card Game (JCC), player versus player.
facts.quote: Este evento comunitario semanal se enfoca en el juego JCC, jugador contra jugador.

article_summaries.title: Evento Comunitario: Reto JCC
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language community event page announcing a weekly player-versus-player Trading Card Game (JCC) event. Players were invited to gather at Crossroads (or enter the JCC lobby from anywhere in the game), and new players were directed to NPC Mar Mita in Pixiewood to start. The event ran on Friday 20 November in two time blocks for two server groups.
